args.description: a short quick swing of the star staff forward at chest height, the staff head staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young woman with very long silver hair, a blue ribbon and violet eyes, a closed high-collared black and white top, a long black coat, loose black shorts reaching her knees over fully opaque black tights from waist to ankle, black boots, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
